# About This Script

This script is for plotting our map (Appendix S1).

```{r}
# devtools::install_github("rspatial/geodata")
# devtools::install_github("rpradosiqueira/brazilmaps")

library(ggnewscale)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl) 
library(sf)     
library(sp)      
library(ggspatial)
library(geobr)   
library(ggplot2) 
library(here)
library(raster)
library(scales)
library(tidyterra)
library(geodata)


```

# Load shapefile of world and our sites coordinates

```{r}

world <- world(path = here("gis/"))

# Load fern sampling coordinates (Latitude and Longitude) from Excel
p <- read_xlsx(here("data/data_ferns.xlsx"), sheet = "e_matrix")[, c("Lat", "Long")]

dim(p)  # Check the dimensions of the coordinates dataframe
```

# Load Atlantic Forest limits and getting states limits

```{r}
flo_typ <- read_sf(here("gis/ma_limite_integrador.shp")) |> 
  st_as_sf()

# Get map of Brazilian states (as 'sf' object)
# states <- geobr::read_state(year=2019, output = "sf")

states <- readRDS(here("gis/gadm36_BRA_1_sp.rds")) |> 
  st_as_sf()

br <- filter(world, NAME_0 == "Brazil") |> st_as_sf()

# plot(states)
```

# Load elevation data
```{r}
elevation <- elevation_30s("BRA", path= here("gis/"), mask = T)
elevation_low <- aggregate(elevation, fact = 4, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
ele_df<- as.data.frame(elevation_low, xy = T) %>% 
  na.omit()


grad_hypso <- hypso.colors(10, "meyers_hypso") # Color gradient
```

# Plotting

```{r}
ggplot() +
  
# Plot the world map in the background
geom_sf(
    data = st_as_sf(world),
    aes(linetype = "Country Limits"),
    color = "gray50",
    fill = "white",
    size = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_tile(data = elevation, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = BRA_elv_msk)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(name = "Elevation (m)",
                       colors = grad_hypso,
                       na.value = NA,
                       limits = c(0, 1900))+ 
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()+

  # Plot the Atlantic Forest polygons
  geom_sf(
    data = flo_typ,
    aes(col = "Atlantic Forest"),
    linewidth = .5,
    fill = "green",
    alpha = .05
  ) +

  # Add Brazilian state borders
  geom_sf(
    data = states,
    aes(linetype = "Brazilian States Limits"),
    color = "black",
    fill = NA,
    lwd = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +

  # Define the fill color for Atlantic Forest
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Atlantic Forest" = "green4"),
    name = NULL
  ) +

  # Define line types for country and state borders
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("Country Limits" = "solid", "Brazilian States Limits" = "solid"),
    name = NULL
  ) +

  # Add caption about data and source
  labs(
    caption = "Datum WGS84\nIntegrative boundaries of the Atlantic Forest (Muylaert et al. 2018)"
  ) +

  # Start a new fill scale so we can add a different legend for the sites
  new_scale_fill() +

  # Add sampling sites as red circles
  geom_point(
    data = p,
    aes(x = Long, y = Lat, fill = "Sites"),
    color = "black",
    size = 3,
    stroke = .5,
    shape = 21,  # Circle with fill
    alpha = .8
  ) +

  # Define the fill color for the sites
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Sites" = "darkred"),
    name = " "
  ) +
  # Zoom to the region of interest (southern Brazil and surroundings)
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(-58, -47.9),
    ylim = c(-33.8, -25),
    crs = 4326,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +

  # Add a scale bar to the map
  annotation_scale(
    location = "br",  # Bottom right
    width_hint = 0.2,
    unit_category = "metric",
    line_width = 2,
    text_cex = 0.6,
    text_col = "black"
  ) +

  # Add a north arrow to the map
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "br",
    which_north = "true",
    style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering(text_size = 0),
    height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    pad_y = unit(0.8, "cm")
  ) +
  # Add ocean and neighboring country labels
  geom_text(aes(x = -49, y = -31, label = "Atlantic Ocean"), angle = 0, size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(x = -56.5, y = -32, label = "Uruguay"), size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(x = -57, y = -28.5, label = "Argentina"), angle = 0, size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(x = -57, y = -26.5, label = "Paraguay"), size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(x = -51.5, y = -25.5, label = "Paraná"), size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(x = -50.8, y = -27.2, label = "Santa Catarina"), size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(x = -53, y = -29.6, label = "Rio Grande do Sul"), size = 3) +


  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +  # Use black-and-white base theme
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    legend.margin = margin(r = 1, l = 1, t = 0.5, b = 1),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
    legend.text.align = 0,
    legend.position = 'top',
    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    # Use blue background for oceans
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "skyblue")
  )


```
